name: Sharp tools
blurb: Password Breakers, Proxy Bypasses and Firewall Bypasses run 15% faster for each rank.

name: Steady hand
blurb: The rings of a port line-up turn about a third slower, and a ring can sit a little off the marker and still lock.

name: Extra thread
blurb: Your gateway runs one more program at once than its processor allows.

name: Overreach
blurb: A program up against a layer stronger than it slows down less: each level it is behind costs half again the time, not double.

name: Auto-align
blurb: Every port line-up starts with one ring already locked, and the bypass is shorter for it.

name: Long way round
blurb: Traces take 8% longer to get past each relay, for each rank.

name: Patience
blurb: Monitors take 40% longer to start a trace after they notice you.

name: Clean sweep
blurb: The Log Deleter works twice as fast.

name: Cold trail
blurb: Targets read their logs half again as late, and the fine for what they find is halved.

name: Slip away
blurb: One more reroute on each connection, and a reroute sends the trace back one relay further.

name: Tuned hardware
blurb: Your processor and modem run 10% faster for each rank.

name: Teardown
blurb: Taking a program file apart gives you one more module out of it, a second copy of the first.

name: Second slot
blurb: Crafted programs take two modules instead of one.

name: Tight builds
blurb: Programs you build take 25% less room for each rank.

name: Refine
blurb: At the Workbench, melt two modules of the same kind and grade down into one a grade better.

name: Fast hands
blurb: Password Breakers, Proxy Bypasses and Firewall Bypasses run another 20% faster for each rank.

name: Deep threads
blurb: Your gateway runs another program at once, on top of Extra thread.

name: Lookout
blurb: Monitors take another 60% longer to start a trace after they notice you.

name: Deep cover
blurb: Traces take another 10% longer to get past each relay, for each rank.

name: Wiper
blurb: The Log Deleter works two and a half times faster again than Clean sweep.

name: Fine tuning
blurb: Your processor and modem run another 10% faster for each rank.

name: Wide pipe
blurb: Files copy and delete 25% faster for each rank, on top of the modem.

name: Third slot
blurb: Crafted programs take one more module again.

name: Salvage
blurb: Taking a program apart gives one more module again.

name: Flat pack
blurb: Crafted programs take another quarter less room.

name: Overclock
blurb: A button under a server's defences, once per connection. Every program running there goes twice as fast for ten seconds. The fans are loud: the monitor notices at once.

name: False trail
blurb: A button on the trace alarm, once per connection. The trace chases a decoy and loses the relay it was on and the one before.

name: Hot patch
blurb: A button under a server's defences, once per connection. A loaded program is rebuilt on the spot to match a layer that outclasses it, and uses up the cheapest module on your shelf.

name: Second wind
blurb: Overclock, False trail and Hot patch each work twice on a connection.

name: Ninth relay
blurb: Your routes take nine relays where everyone else's stop at eight.

name: Deep memory
blurb: Your gateway's memory holds 10 GB more than the part allows.
